info.name: Choturvuz Fashion E-commerce API
info.description:
REST API for the Choturvuz fashion storefront.

**Base URL:** `{{base_url}}` (default `http://localhost:8000`)

**Response envelope** — every endpoint returns:

```json
{
  "status": 200,
  "success": true,
  "message": "...",
  "data": { },
  "meta": { }
}
```

Errors use `success: false` plus an `errors` object.

**Auth** — Admin endpoints require a staff JWT: log in via `Admin · Auth / Admin Login` (the token is captured automatically into `{{admin_token}}`). Customer account endpoints use `{{user_token}}`. Ordering and tracking need **no auth** — email or phone identifies the guest customer.

**Money** — all amounts are in BDT (`Decimal(12,2)`).

**Order lifecycle** — `PENDING_PAYMENT → CONFIRMED → PROCESSING → SHIPPED → DELIVERED`, with `CANCELLED` reachable from any active state (restores stock, flags refunds). Illegal jumps are rejected.

**Payment plans** — `FULL` charges the whole total via bKash; `HALF` charges a 50% advance and the rest is due on delivery (recorded by an admin). Configure bKash via the `BKASH_*` env vars before initiating payments.

item.name: Client · Orders & Payments
item.description: Guest checkout and tracking. No authentication required — the customer's email or phone is the identifier.

request.description:
Place an order as a guest.

- At least one of `customer_email` / `customer_phone` is required.
- `payment_plan`: `FULL` or `HALF` (50% advance, rest on delivery; can be disabled in store config).
- `items[].variant_id` comes from a product detail's `variants[].id`. Quantities are capped at 20 per line.
- Prices and the delivery fee (inside vs outside Dhaka) are computed server-side; the order starts as `PENDING_PAYMENT`.
- Returns **409** when stock runs short.

request.description: Track an order with its order number plus the email **or** phone used when placing it. Returns the order with items, the full status timeline (`events`), and payment history. Mismatched identifiers return 404 (no data leak).

response.name: Track Order

variable.description: The order number to pay for.

request.description:
Creates a bKash tokenized-checkout session for the amount due under the order's plan (`FULL` → total, `HALF` → 50% advance). Redirect the customer's browser to `data.payment_url`; bKash then returns them to the configured callback which captures the money and confirms the order automatically.

Requires the `BKASH_*` environment variables; returns a clear error otherwise. Only `PENDING_PAYMENT` orders can be paid.

response.name: Start bKash Payment

query.description: bKash payment ID from the create response.

request.description: The bKash redirect target (configured via `BKASH_CALLBACK_URL`). You normally never call this by hand: bKash sends the customer's browser here, the API executes/captures the payment (or marks it failed/cancelled), then issues a **302 redirect** to `{USER_FRONTEND_URL}/orders/track?order_number=...&payment=success|failed|cancelled`.

item.name: Admin · Catalog
item.description: Product, variant, image, and collection management.

request.description: All products in any status, with nested variants, images, and collections.

Creates a product with nested images and variants in one call.

- `slug` is derived from the name.
- `sale_price` must be ≤ `base_price`.
- Variant `size` ∈ `XS, S, M, L, XL, XXL, ONE_SIZE`; `sku` is globally unique; `price` (optional) overrides the product price.
- `images[]` URLs usually come from `Client · Store Config & Files / Upload File`.

Partial update. Sending `variants` performs an upsert: entries with `id` are updated, without `id` are created, and existing variants omitted from the list are deleted. `images` and `collection_ids` follow replace semantics when provided.
Hard-deletes the product and its variants/images. Historical order lines keep their name/price snapshots.
Creates a collection, optionally seeding it with products via `product_ids`. Removing/deleting a collection never deletes its products.
Collection details; the response includes the assigned `product_ids`.
Partial update; pass `product_ids` to replace the product membership.
Deletes only the collection (and its product memberships). Products are never removed.
Assigns or removes products in bulk. `action` ∈ `add` (append), `remove`, or `set` (replace membership). Responds with the updated `product_ids` list.

item.name: Admin · Orders & Payments
item.description: Order operations: view, lifecycle transitions, and offline payment recording.

query.description: Order number, customer name, email, or phone.

request.description: Paginated order list with item counts and due amounts.
Full order: items, timeline events, payments, customer, and money breakdown.

Moves the order to the next lifecycle step and appends a timeline event.

Allowed moves: `PENDING_PAYMENT → CONFIRMED/CANCELLED`, `CONFIRMED → PROCESSING/CANCELLED`, `PROCESSING → SHIPPED/CANCELLED`, `SHIPPED → DELIVERED/CANCELLED`. Cancelling restores reserved stock and flags paid amounts as `REFUNDED`. Illegal jumps return 400.
Records money collected outside bKash — the due half on delivery, or full cash on delivery. Rejects amounts above the due balance. Updates `paid_amount` / `payment_status` and logs a timeline note.

query.description: Order number, bKash payment ID, or trx ID.

request.description: Every payment attempt (bKash and recorded offline) across orders.

Partial update of the singleton config. Accepts flat fields or sectioned objects (`branding`, `legal_document`, `feature`, `announcement`, `commerce`, `seo`); also accepts a multipart `logo` image. Requires superuser.
